## Script: `send_report.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import smtplib
import getpass
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email import encoders
from pathlib import Path

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SMTP_SERVER = "smtp.gmail.com"
SMTP_PORT = 587
FROM_ADDR = "alice@example.com"
TO_ADDR = "bob@example.com"
SUBJECT = "Customer Activity Report for Maya Chen"
BODY = (
    "Please find attached the Customer Activity Report for Maya Chen, "
    "including orders ORD-6C71B1 ($79) and ORD-5B048F ($108)."
)
PDF_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "customer_report.pdf"
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def build_message():
    msg = MIMEMultipart()
    msg["From"] = FROM_ADDR
    msg["To"] = TO_ADDR
    msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT
    msg.attach(MIMEText(BODY, "plain"))

    if not PDF_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"PDF not found at: {PDF_PATH}")

    with open(PDF_PATH, "rb") as f:
        attachment = MIMEBase("application", "pdf")
        attachment.set_payload(f.read())

    encoders.encode_base64(attachment)
    attachment.add_header(
        "Content-Disposition",
        f'attachment; filename="{PDF_PATH.name}"',
    )
    msg.attach(attachment)
    return msg

def send_email():
    print(f"From:       {FROM_ADDR}")
    print(f"To:         {TO_ADDR}")
    print(f"Subject:    {SUBJECT}")
    print(f"Attachment: {PDF_PATH.name}")
    print()

    password = getpass.getpass("Enter Gmail app-specific password: ")

    msg = build_message()

    print("\nConnecting to SMTP server...")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_SERVER, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(FROM_ADDR, password)
        server.send_message(msg)

    print("✅ Email sent successfully!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    send_email()
```
